chapterInfo.content:
33
1Na afei, Hiob, tie me kasa ɛ,
na yɛ aso ma me nsɛm nyinaa.
2Hwɛ, mabue m’ano,
me tɛkyerɛma rekasa me dodom.
3M’akomam teeyɛ ne me nsɛm,
m’ano ka nimdeɛ kronkron.
4Nyankopɔn honhom na ɛyɛɛ me,
na Otumfoɔ no ahome na ɛmaa me nkwa.
5Sɛ wobɛtumi a, yi ano kyerɛ me;
Siesie wo ho m’anim, sɔre gyina.
6 # Hiob 10.9 Hwɛ, me nso meyɛ Nyankopɔn deɛ sɛ wo ara,
anwommoɔ mu na wɔtii me nso firiiɛ.
7Hwɛ, me ho hu rentu w’akoma,
na me nhyɛsoɔ renyɛ wo so duru.
8Ampa, woaka no m’aso mu,
na nsɛm nne na metee sɛ wose:
9 # Hiob 16.17; 27.6; 31 Me deɛ, me ho te, mmarato nni me ho;
me ho yɛ tɔtorɔtɔɔ, amumuyɛ biara nni me ho.
10 # Hiob 13.24; 19.11 Hwɛ, ɔhunu ntɔkwa nsɛm wɔ me ho,
ɔbu me sɛ ne tamfo.
11 # Hiob 13.27 Ɔde me nan hyɛ mpokyerɛ mu,
ɔkari m’akwan nyinaa.
12Hwɛ, yei mu na wontene, merebua wo;
na Onyankopɔn so sene ɔdasani.
13Adɛn nti na wo ne no ham,
sɛ ɔmmua ne nsɛm nyinaa ho?
14Nso Onyankopɔn kasa prɛko
ne deɛ ɛtia mprenu, nanso onipa nnwene ho.
15Daeɛ mu, anadwo adehunu mu,
nnahɔɔ a atɔ nnipa soɔ mu,
mpa so nnaeɛ mu,
16 # Hiob 36.10; Dwom 16.7 emu na ɔbue nnipa aso,
na ɔsɔ wɔn atenetene ano,
17 # Dwom 119.67, 71 sɛ ɔbɛsane onipa afiri ne nneyɛɛ ho,
na wayi ahantan ahunta onipa,
18na watwe ne kra afiri Amena mu,
ne ne nkwa nso na antɔ afena ano.
19Na wɔde yea twe n’aso ne mpa so
ne ne nnompe mu daa aperedie.
20Na ne nkwa ma aduane fono no,
na ne kra po akɔnnɔduane.
21Ne honam afɔn ama no ayɛ hununa,
na ne nnompe a anka wɔnhunu mpo ada adi.
22Na ne kra bɛn ɔsɛeɛ Amena,
na ne nkwa nso bɛn akumfoɔ.
23 # Heb 1.14 Sɛ ɔbɔfoɔ dimafoɔ wɔ hɔ ma no,
apem no mu ɔbaako,
sɛ ɔrekyerɛ onipa deɛ ɛtene ma no a,
24ɛno na ɔhu no mmɔbɔ ka sɛ: Kɔgye no,
na wankɔ ɔsɛeɛ Amena no mu,
na manya agyedeɛ, a,
25 # Dwom 103.5 ɛnneɛ ne honam yɛ sɔɔsɔɔ sɛ mmɔfra deɛ,
ɔsane kɔ ne mmeranteberɛ mu.
26Ɔkoto Onyankopɔn a, n’ani sɔ no,
na ɔhunu n’anim anigyeɛ mu,
na ɔdane ɔdasani tenenee ma no,
27na ɔto dwom kyerɛ nnipa sɛ:
Mayɛ bɔne, na makyea deɛ ɛtene no,
nanso ɔne me anni no sɛdeɛ ɛfata me.
28 # Hiob 33.18 Wagye me kra na ankɔ ɔsɛeɛ Amena mu,
na me nkwa rehunu hann no.
29Hwɛ, yeinom nyinaa na Onyankopɔn yɛ
mprenu ne mprɛnsa wɔ onipa ho,
30 # Dwom 56.13; 103.4 sɛ ɔbɛsane ne kra afiri ɔsɛeɛ Amena ho,
na wanya hann, nkwa hann no mu.
31Yɛ aso, Hiob, na tie me;
yɛ komm, na menkasa.
32Sɛ nsɛm bi wɔ hɔ a, yi ano kyerɛ me,
kasa, na wo bemdie bɛyɛ me fɛ.
33Sɛ ɛnte saa a, ɛnneɛ tie me ara,
yɛ komm, na menkyerɛ wo nyansa.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na afei, Hiob, tie me kasa ɛ,
na yɛ aso ma me nsɛm nyinaa.
Hwɛ, mabue m’ano,
me tɛkyerɛma rekasa me dodom.
M’akomam teeyɛ ne me nsɛm,
m’ano ka nimdeɛ kronkron.
Nyankopɔn honhom na ɛyɛɛ me,
na Otumfoɔ no ahome na ɛmaa me nkwa.
Sɛ wobɛtumi a, yi ano kyerɛ me;
Siesie wo ho m’anim, sɔre gyina.
Hwɛ, me nso meyɛ Nyankopɔn deɛ sɛ wo ara,
anwommoɔ mu na wɔtii me nso firiiɛ.
Hwɛ, me ho hu rentu w’akoma,
na me nhyɛsoɔ renyɛ wo so duru.

Ampa, woaka no m’aso mu,
na nsɛm nne na metee sɛ wose:
Me deɛ, me ho te, mmarato nni me ho;
me ho yɛ tɔtorɔtɔɔ, amumuyɛ biara nni me ho.
Hwɛ, ɔhunu ntɔkwa nsɛm wɔ me ho,
ɔbu me sɛ ne tamfo.
Ɔde me nan hyɛ mpokyerɛ mu,
ɔkari m’akwan nyinaa.

Hwɛ, yei mu na wontene, merebua wo;
na Onyankopɔn so sene ɔdasani.
Adɛn nti na wo ne no ham,
sɛ ɔmmua ne nsɛm nyinaa ho?
Nso Onyankopɔn kasa prɛko
ne deɛ ɛtia mprenu, nanso onipa nnwene ho.
Daeɛ mu, anadwo adehunu mu,
nnahɔɔ a atɔ nnipa soɔ mu,
mpa so nnaeɛ mu,
emu na ɔbue nnipa aso,
na ɔsɔ wɔn atenetene ano,
sɛ ɔbɛsane onipa afiri ne nneyɛɛ ho,
na wayi ahantan ahunta onipa,
na watwe ne kra afiri Amena mu,
ne ne nkwa nso na antɔ afena ano.

Na wɔde yea twe n’aso ne mpa so
ne ne nnompe mu daa aperedie.
Na ne nkwa ma aduane fono no,
na ne kra po akɔnnɔduane.
Ne honam afɔn ama no ayɛ hununa,
na ne nnompe a anka wɔnhunu mpo ada adi.
Na ne kra bɛn ɔsɛeɛ Amena,
na ne nkwa nso bɛn akumfoɔ.

Sɛ ɔbɔfoɔ dimafoɔ wɔ hɔ ma no,
apem no mu ɔbaako,
sɛ ɔrekyerɛ onipa deɛ ɛtene ma no a,
ɛno na ɔhu no mmɔbɔ ka sɛ: Kɔgye no,
na wankɔ ɔsɛeɛ Amena no mu,
na manya agyedeɛ, a,
ɛnneɛ ne honam yɛ sɔɔsɔɔ sɛ mmɔfra deɛ,
ɔsane kɔ ne mmeranteberɛ mu.
Ɔkoto Onyankopɔn a, n’ani sɔ no,
na ɔhunu n’anim anigyeɛ mu,
na ɔdane ɔdasani tenenee ma no,
na ɔto dwom kyerɛ nnipa sɛ:
Mayɛ bɔne, na makyea deɛ ɛtene no,
nanso ɔne me anni no sɛdeɛ ɛfata me.
Wagye me kra na ankɔ ɔsɛeɛ Amena mu,
na me nkwa rehunu hann no.

Hwɛ, yeinom nyinaa na Onyankopɔn yɛ
mprenu ne mprɛnsa wɔ onipa ho,
sɛ ɔbɛsane ne kra afiri ɔsɛeɛ Amena ho,
na wanya hann, nkwa hann no mu.
Yɛ aso, Hiob, na tie me;
yɛ komm, na menkasa.
Sɛ nsɛm bi wɔ hɔ a, yi ano kyerɛ me,
kasa, na wo bemdie bɛyɛ me fɛ.
Sɛ ɛnte saa a, ɛnneɛ tie me ara,
yɛ komm, na menkyerɛ wo nyansa.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
